info.title: genie-agent-evalops
info.description: EvalOps for Databricks Genie Agents. All endpoints act as the signed-in viewer (on-behalf-of).

get.description: No auth. Reports whether Lakebase is durable or the in-memory fallback is active.

The viewer's email, the spaces they manage, and the spaces they review.

Also registers the viewer as a reviewer of exactly those spaces: the review job assigns
labeling sessions to registered reviewers, because it cannot list a group's members.
Criteria loaded at startup and their content-hash version.
State of a `collect` job run. Runs of any other job are reported as not found.

Every space where the viewer holds CAN_MANAGE, with 30-day coverage, hard-gate pass rate and
the last collection. Spaces the collector cannot read show `monitored: false`.

schema.title: Response List Spaces Api Spaces Get

get.description: Coverage breakdown, pass rate per criterion and the daily trend for the window.
Newest first. Filter by verdict or by a failing criterion.

parameters.name: criterion

schema.description: Only traces failing this criterion id.
schema.title: Criterion

parameters.description: Only traces failing this criterion id.

get.summary: Human review progress and judge agreement
get.description:
How many traces of the current session are labelled, and each judge's TPR / TNR on `fail`
with Wilson lower bounds. Space owners only, like every route here.

get.summary: The agent's quality and operations by week
get.description:
Per UTC week asked: answers, the must-pass rate under the latest rules, task success as
judged by people with its 95% interval, each judge's raw and corrected fail rate, and time to
answer.

get.summary: Each judge's agreement history and latest-run behaviour
get.description:
Per (criterion version, judge): TPR / TNR lower bounds at every review run, and in the
current verdicts its `na` share, vote stability, errors and tokens.

get.summary: Each reviewer's activity, strictness and agreement
get.description:
Per reviewer: turns and labels, turnaround, fail rates beside the space's, reasons given,
agreement with the judges; and Cohen's kappa between every two reviewers on the turns both
reviewed.

get.summary: Reviewed turns that failed or have findings
get.description:
What reviewers found: each failed turn or turn with findings, the criteria that caught
it (none = a blind spot) and its failure categories, plus the categories ranked by
frequency x impact.

post.description: 409 if the space already has a category of that name (case-insensitive).

patch.summary: Rename, describe, rate or link a category
patch.description: `criterion_id` must be a loaded criterion: the one that now covers this failure.

delete.summary: Delete a category and its tags

get.summary: Draft a criterion from a category
get.description:
A criterion YAML to edit and add to the criteria folder, with the category's reviewed
answers as examples. Nothing is written: criteria stay files under review.

put.description: Replaces the list; an empty list untags. Every id must be a category of this space.

get.summary: Where the judges and the reviewers disagree
get.description:
Every labelled turn whose current judge verdict differs from the reviewer's label, with
both reasons and the owner's diagnosis. Owners only: it shows
judge verdicts, which reviewers must not see before they label.

put.summary: Mark why a judge and a reviewer disagree
put.description: 404 unless it is a current disagreement in this space.

post.description:
Trigger the `collect` job for this space (as the app's identity, after the viewer's
CAN_MANAGE was checked). Returns the job run id to poll at `GET /runs/{job_run_id}`.

get.description: The current version of every case, and per failure category how many active cases cover it.

post.description: 422 if `expect.criteria` names a rule that is not loaded or `category_ids` one not in the space.

get.summary: A case prefilled from a collected answer
get.description:
The conversation's questions up to that answer, the rules people said apply to it, the
reviewer's reason and the answer's failure categories. Nothing is saved.

get.summary: What to add to or retire from the eval set
get.description:
From production questions' intents (tagged by the review job) against the cases': intents
users ask that no case covers, cases nobody's questions match, flaky and duplicate cases.
The current version of every case, readable back by the import.

post.description:
The body is the YAML file as the export writes it. New cases are created, changed ones
get a new version, the rest are left alone. The whole file is validated before anything is saved.

put.summary: How cases are split into dev and test
put.description:
Applies to cases assigned from now on; existing splits stay until a re-split. Saved as a
new version of the space's profile.

post.description:
Assign every active case without a split (runs do this too); with `reset`, re-split all
automatically assigned cases first.

put.summary: Put one case in dev or test
put.description: The owner's call, kept through re-splits; `split: null` hands the case back to automatic assignment.

Saves a new version (retire a case by saving it with `status: retired`). 409 if someone
saved a newer version since `base_version`.

schema.title: Response Case History Api Spaces  Space Id  Evalset  Case Id  History Get

get.description: The latest 20 runs, newest first, each with pass^k / pass@k / flaky counts per arm.

post.summary: Run the eval set on the current configuration
post.description:
Start the `evaluate` job (as the app, after the viewer's CAN_MANAGE was checked). The run
appears in the list when the job starts; poll the job at `GET /runs/{job_run_id}`.

get.description: Every case with each arm's outcome over its k attempts, and every graded answer.

schema.title: Response List Changes Api Spaces  Space Id  Changes Get

post.description:
Checked against the space's configuration as it is now, read with the viewer's token:
422 if an operation does not fit it (a line that is not there, a table the space lacks).

post.summary: Run the eval set on the current configuration and on it with this change
Apply a tested change to the space, with your own permission
post.description:
Written to the space with the viewer's token, so the space's history shows who did it.
409 unless the latest test was accepted (or `override`) and the space is still the
configuration the change was written against.

post.summary: Put back the configuration an applied change replaced
post.description: 409 if the space was edited after the change was applied (rolling back would undo that too).

post.summary: Draft a change that should fix a failure category
post.description:
An LLM draft from the category's reviewed answers, its eval cases and the configuration as
it is now. Nothing is saved: the owner edits the draft, saves it as a change and tests it.

get.summary: One trace, its steps and its verdicts
get.description:
Returns 404 both when the trace does not exist and when it belongs to a space the viewer
does not manage, so a trace's existence never leaks.

The latest 50 check, eval and review runs with what produced them, the agent's
configuration history, and runs where the agent changed although nothing we control did.

Every field, rule, prompt, guideline and case that differs from run `a` to run `b`, with
the texts before and after. 404 unless both runs belong to the space.

Every rule, judge, case check and the human reviewers, with each one's calibration or
measurement and whether it may decide a gate run (the space's own rules and judges).
The latest version (version 0 = nothing saved yet: the library defaults apply).

put.description:
409 if someone saved after `base_version`; 422 if a skill or custom rule changed what it
returns without a new version, or the profile names rules or skills the library lacks.

get.description: Newest first.

schema.title: Response Profile History Api Spaces  Space Id  Profile History Get

get.description: Every setting that differs from version a to version b (0 = the library defaults).

post.description: Saves that version's settings as a new version: history only grows.

get.description: For review in git; the import reads it back.

post.summary: Save a YAML profile as a new version
post.description: Validated like any save; saved on top of the latest version.

get.summary: What applies to the space now
get.description:
Each rule (library, overridden or custom), each skill with its model and settings, the
thresholds and the gate.
The deployment's rules, skills (prompt and settings) and default thresholds.

AccessStatus.title: AccessStatus
AccessStatus.description: Whether a conversation could be read, and so whether it can be graded.

text.title: Text
text.description: One instruction line, appended to the text instructions.

count.title: Count
count.description: Production questions with this intent in the window.

examples.title: Examples
examples.description: The latest few, to promote one with 'Add to eval set'.

AddSuggestion.title: AddSuggestion
AddSuggestion.description: Users keep asking this and no active case covers it.

weeks.title: Weeks
weeks.description: Oldest first, every week of the window, empty weeks included.

versions.title: Versions
versions.description: Configuration changes in the window, oldest first.

AgentPerformance.title: AgentPerformance
AgentPerformance.description:
`GET /spaces/{space_id}/performance/agent`: the agent's quality and operations by week,
every week measured with the traces' current verdicts.

graded.title: Graded
graded.description: Answers whose conversation could be read (access_status ok).

hard_failed.title: Hard Failed
hard_failed.description: Of those, answers a must-pass rule failed.

reviewed.title: Reviewed
reviewed.description: Answers with a task-success verdict from a reviewer (latest review).

task_low.title: Task Low
task_low.description: Wilson 95% interval of task success, low end.

task_high.title: Task High
task_high.description: Wilson 95% interval of task success, high end.

median_seconds.title: Median Seconds
median_seconds.description: Median time from question to answer.

sql_steps.title: Sql Steps
sql_steps.description: Mean SQL steps per graded answer.

genie_errors.title: Genie Errors
genie_errors.description: Answers that ended in a Genie error.

AgentWeek.title: AgentWeek
AgentWeek.description: One UTC week (Monday start) of `GET /spaces/{space_id}/performance/agent`, by the week asked.

override.title: Override
override.description: Apply although the latest test was not accepted (the owner's explicit call).

pass_all.title: Pass All
pass_all.description: pass^k: every attempt passed (and none errored).

pass_any.title: Pass Any
pass_any.description: pass@k: at least one attempt passed.

flaky.title: Flaky
flaky.description: Passed some attempts and failed others: Genie's noise, not a verdict.

ArmOutcome.title: ArmOutcome
ArmOutcome.description: One case on one arm across its k attempts.

errored.title: Errored
errored.description: Cases with at least one attempt that could not be graded.

name.title: Name
name.description: Criterion id, skill name, or label schema name (e.g. `task_success__v3`).

ArtifactRef.title: ArtifactRef
ArtifactRef.description: One rule, prompt or guideline, by content hash; its text is in Delta `artifacts`.

BlindSpot.title: BlindSpot
BlindSpot.description: An answer a reviewer failed on task success that no check failed: no rule covers it yet.

judge.title: Judge
judge.description: The judge configuration measured (skill, model, settings).

tpr.title: Tpr
tpr.description: Good answers the judge passed (positive class = pass).

tnr.title: Tnr
tnr.description: Bad answers the judge failed: recall of the fail class.

precision.title: Precision
precision.description: Fail precision: of the answers the judge failed, those people failed.

Calibration.title: Calibration
Calibration.description:
An LLM judge against people, on the labels where the reviewer said the rule applies.
Positive class = fail (the minority class: what a gate must catch).

target.title: Target
target.description: The change was written to fix this case.

example_match.title: Example Match
example_match.description: A dev case whose question the change adds as a SQL example: allowed, but its fix proves little.

unconfirmed_by.title: Unconfirmed By
unconfirmed_by.description: The outcome rests only on these uncalibrated evaluators, so it does not decide.

split.title: Split
split.description: The case's split when the run asked it.

CaseSource.title: CaseSource
CaseSource.description: Where a case came from, when it was promoted from a reviewed answer.

stratum.title: Stratum
stratum.description: The stratum it was assigned in, e.g. `type=core / intent=ranking`.

assigned_by.title: Assigned By
assigned_by.description: `auto`, or the owner who overrode it.

impact.title: Impact
impact.description: 5 = harm (privacy, safety, compliance); 4 = a wrong answer the user would act on; 3 = wrong or incomplete, likely noticed; 2 = extra effort (rephrase, follow-up); 1 = minor annoyance.

impact.title: Impact
impact.description: 5 = harm (privacy, safety, compliance); 4 = a wrong answer the user would act on; 3 = wrong or incomplete, likely noticed; 2 = extra effort (rephrase, follow-up); 1 = minor annoyance.

criterion_id.title: Criterion Id
criterion_id.description: The criterion that now covers it, if any.

failed.title: Failed
failed.description: Of those, turns a reviewer failed.

caught.title: Caught
caught.description: Of the tagged turns, how many at least one criterion failed.

frequency.title: Frequency
frequency.description: turns / reviewed turns; None before any review.

priority.title: Priority
priority.description: frequency_score x impact, 1-25: work on the highest first.

linked_caught.title: Linked Caught
linked_caught.description: Of the tagged turns, how many the linked criterion failed (None if unlinked).

linked_false_alarms.title: Linked False Alarms
linked_false_alarms.description: Turns reviewers passed that the linked criterion failed (None if unlinked).

CategorySummary.title: CategorySummary
CategorySummary.description: A category with how often it happens and how much of it the criteria catch.

anyOf.description: 5 = harm (privacy, safety, compliance); 4 = a wrong answer the user would act on; 3 = wrong or incomplete, likely noticed; 2 = extra effort (rephrase, follow-up); 1 = minor annoyance.

CategoryUpdate.title: CategoryUpdate
CategoryUpdate.description: Only the fields sent change; send `criterion_id: null` to unlink.

rationale.title: Rationale
rationale.description: Why: the failure it should fix.

draft.description: None when the model found nothing to change.

dropped.title: Dropped
dropped.description: Proposed operations left out because they do not fit the configuration.

ChangeProposal.title: ChangeProposal
ChangeProposal.description: A drafted change from a failure category, for the owner to edit and test (never applied as is).

split.title: Split
split.description: dev = iterate (any number of times); test = the gate run that decides.

scope.description: Dev runs only: ask part of the eval set.

rationale.title: Rationale
rationale.description: Why: the failure it should fix.

base_version.title: Base Version
base_version.description: Configuration version the change was written against.

leaks.title: Leaks
leaks.description: SQL examples it adds that match an active eval case's question. On a test case it is train/test leakage (the case cannot count as fixed); on a dev case it is allowed and listed.

test_targets.title: Test Targets
test_targets.description: Target cases in the test split: the change is tuned on the test set.

gate_runs.title: Gate Runs
gate_runs.description: Finished gate runs (in the list and on one change; not after an action).

decides.title: Decides
decides.description: True for a gate run: only it can let a change be applied.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Worth knowing, not part of the verdict.

gate.title: Gate
gate.description: The space's gate, check by check.

Comparison.title: Comparison
Comparison.description:
Baseline vs candidate. Accept = nothing broke and every target case is fixed; reject = a
case broke or a target still fails; otherwise inconclusive (flaky or ungraded targets).
Only a gate run's comparison decides; a dev run's is for iterating.

Coverage.title: Coverage
Coverage.description: How many traces could be graded, split by why not.

version.title: Version
version.description: Content hash of the loaded criteria files.

title.title: Title
title.description: Short name for people, shown in the UI.

CriterionDraft.title: CriterionDraft
CriterionDraft.description:
`GET /spaces/{space_id}/categories/{category_id}/draft`: a criterion file to edit and add
to the criteria folder. Criteria stay files under review; the app never writes them.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: missed_failure = the reviewer failed it, the judge did not; false_alarm = the judge failed what the reviewer passed; applicability = they disagree on whether the rule applies.

Disagreement.title: Disagreement
Disagreement.description:
A labelled turn where a judge's current verdict differs from the reviewer's label, for
the same criterion version. Owners only.

flipped.title: Flipped
flipped.description: Cases that passed k of k in one run and failed k of k in the other.

DriftFlag.title: DriftFlag
DriftFlag.description:
Two scheduled gate runs on an identical manifest whose results differ case by case: the
agent changed although nothing we control did (Genie's platform or model).

EffectiveProfile.title: EffectiveProfile
EffectiveProfile.description: `GET /spaces/{id}/profile/effective`: what actually applies to the space.

ErrorBody.title: ErrorBody
ErrorBody.description: The inside of an error response.

turns.title: Turns
turns.description: Asked in order, in one conversation.

type.title: Type
type.description: core = what users mostly ask; edge = unusual but valid; guardrail = must refuse or hold back (privacy, out of scope).

origin.title: Origin
origin.description: How the case came about; `synthetic` = made-up data for checking the platform itself.

change_id.description: The change the candidate arm applied.

change_id.title: Change Id
change_id.description: The change the candidate arm applied.

split.title: Split
split.description: dev = an iteration run; test = a gate run (test cases plus the change's targets); all = every active case (runs before splits existed).

scope.title: Scope
scope.description: The part of the eval set a dev run asked; empty = all of it.

comparison.description: When the run tested a change.

EvalSet.title: EvalSet
EvalSet.description:
`GET /spaces/{space_id}/evalset`: the current version of every case, and which failure
categories have none (they come first).

tagged_questions.title: Tagged Questions
tagged_questions.description: Production questions in the window that have an intent.

untagged_questions.title: Untagged Questions
untagged_questions.description: Not tagged yet: the review job tags them on its next run.

leaks.title: Leaks
leaks.description: Cases whose question is already a SQL example of the space (as of the last collect).

scope.description: Dev runs only: ask part of the eval set.

can_decide.title: Can Decide
can_decide.description: May fail a case in a gate run. Uncalibrated judges only report.

gate.title: Gate
gate.description: Criteria only: hard, soft or monitor.

turn.title: Turn
turn.description: Index of the graded turn; default the last.

criteria.title: Criteria
criteria.description: Rules that must apply and pass (`pass`), or must not apply (`na`), on this question.

facts.title: Facts
facts.description: What a correct answer states or does, in words.

reference_sql.title: Reference Sql
reference_sql.description: A query run live as the tester at ask time; its values must appear in the report.

Expect.title: Expect
Expect.description:
What the graded turn (the last unless `turn` says otherwise) must do. Every hard rule must
pass anyway; these add what this question in particular needs.

passed.title: Passed
passed.description: None when it could not be decided (a judge or query error).

impact.title: Impact
impact.description: 5 = harm (privacy, safety, compliance); 4 = a wrong answer the user would act on; 3 = wrong or incomplete, likely noticed; 2 = extra effort (rephrase, follow-up); 1 = minor annoyance.

criterion_id.title: Criterion Id
criterion_id.description: The criterion that now covers it, if any.

FailureCategory.title: FailureCategory
FailureCategory.description: A kind of failure an owner named while reading observations.

Family.title: Family
Family.description: Method family; families 1-4 need no human calibration. Rubric judges come last.

FlakySuggestion.title: FlakySuggestion
FlakySuggestion.description: Split verdicts on the current configuration in several runs: it measures Genie's noise.

Gate.title: Gate
Gate.description: `hard` failures fail the trace; `soft` and `monitor` are reported separately.

passed.title: Passed
passed.description: None when it could not be measured (no such cases).

decides.title: Decides
decides.description: False when it rests on a judge that is not calibrated.

GateCheck.title: GateCheck
GateCheck.description: One line of a gate: what was measured, by whom, against what limit.

min_test_pass_rate.title: Min Test Pass Rate
min_test_pass_rate.description: Absolute floor: the candidate's test pass^k rate.

max_drop.title: Max Drop
max_drop.description: Relative: candidate test pass^k at most this far below baseline.

type_floors.title: Type Floors
type_floors.description: Per-slice floors: the candidate's pass^k rate per case type.

guardrail_zero_tolerance.title: Guardrail Zero Tolerance
guardrail_zero_tolerance.description: Any failed attempt of a guardrail case on the candidate rejects.

max_over_refusal.title: Max Over Refusal
max_over_refusal.description: Share of cases expecting an answer that the candidate declined; also never above baseline.

max_p95_latency_increase.title: Max P95 Latency Increase
max_p95_latency_increase.description: Candidate p95 time to answer at most this share above baseline.

GateConfig.title: GateConfig
GateConfig.description:
What a gate run must show, beyond "nothing broke and every target is fixed" (always on).
Each limit is optional; unset = not checked.

steps.title: Steps
steps.description: The graded turn's steps (result rows cut to 20), so a reviewer can check the answer.

na.title: Na
na.description: Verdicts saying the rule does not apply.

sampled.title: Sampled
sampled.description: Verdicts with a vote among several samples.

unanimous.title: Unanimous
unanimous.description: Of those, verdicts where every sample agreed (vote stability).

judged.title: Judged
judged.description: Verdicts judged in this run; the rest were reused from an earlier one.

tokens_per_verdict.title: Tokens Per Verdict
tokens_per_verdict.description: Mean tokens of the verdicts judged in this run.

JudgeBehaviour.title: JudgeBehaviour
JudgeBehaviour.description: What a rubric judge says in the current verdicts.

min_lower_bound.title: Min Lower Bound
min_lower_bound.description: Both Wilson lower bounds must reach this to calibrate.

queued.title: Queued
queued.description: Traces in the current labeling session.

labeled.title: Labeled
labeled.description: Of those, traces with at least one label, as of the last review run.

reviewed.title: Reviewed
reviewed.description: Turns with a task-success verdict from a reviewer.

task_failed.title: Task Failed
task_failed.description: Of those, turns the reviewer said do not answer the question.

caught.title: Caught
caught.description: Of the failed turns, how many at least one check failed (rule coverage).

blind_spots.title: Blind Spots
blind_spots.description: Failed turns no check caught: where new rules come from.

conversations.title: Conversations
conversations.description: Conversations with at least one reviewed turn.

multi_turn.title: Multi Turn
multi_turn.description: Of those, conversations with more than one reviewed turn.

conversations_strict.title: Conversations Strict
conversations_strict.description: Conversations whose every reviewed turn passed (an earlier failure counts).

conversations_outcome.title: Conversations Outcome
conversations_outcome.description: Conversations whose last reviewed turn passed (the user got there in the end).

judges.title: Judges
judges.description: One row per (criterion, criterion version, judge).

JudgeCalibration.title: JudgeCalibration
JudgeCalibration.description:
`GET /spaces/{space_id}/calibration`: how far human review has got, and how well each
LLM judge agrees with it. Owners only: reviewers must not see judge verdicts (blind review).

JudgeHistoryPoint.title: JudgeHistoryPoint
JudgeHistoryPoint.description: A judge's agreement with people as computed by one review run.

n.title: N
n.description: Labels paired with a judge verdict (judge errors excluded).

exact.title: Exact
exact.description: Pairs where judge and human gave the same of pass/fail/na.

n_applies.title: N Applies
n_applies.description: Pairs where the human said the rule applies: what TPR, TNR and kappa count.

applicability_agree.title: Applicability Agree
applicability_agree.description: Pairs where judge and human agree on whether the rule applies (na or not).

calibrated.title: Calibrated
calibrated.description: Both lower bounds reach the threshold.

positive_class.title: Positive Class
positive_class.description: TPR counts this class: good answers judged pass.

kappa.title: Kappa
kappa.description: Cohen's kappa on fail vs not fail: agreement beyond chance. None when undefined (every pair in one class).

observed_applies.title: Observed Applies
observed_applies.description: Turns the judge (current verdicts) said the rule applies to.

observed_fails.title: Observed Fails
observed_fails.description: Of those, turns the judge failed.

corrected_fail_rate.title: Corrected Fail Rate
corrected_fail_rate.description: The judge's fail rate corrected for its measured TPR and TNR (Rogan-Gladen): (observed + TNR - 1) / (TPR + TNR - 1), clipped to 0-1. None until both are measured and the judge beats chance (TPR + TNR > 1).

JudgeRow.title: JudgeRow
JudgeRow.description: A judge's agreement with people, and what it says about the judge's own fail rate.

points.title: Points
points.description: Oldest first, one per review run.

JudgeTrack.title: JudgeTrack
JudgeTrack.description: One (criterion version, judge): a new judge or rule version starts its own track.

applies.title: Applies
applies.description: Turns asked that week the judge said the rule applies to (current verdicts).

corrected_fail_rate.title: Corrected Fail Rate
corrected_fail_rate.description: The fail rate corrected for the judge's measured TPR and TNR.

JudgeWeek.title: JudgeWeek
JudgeWeek.description: One rubric judge in one week of the agent chart.

turn.title: Turn
turn.description: Which turn of the case (0 = the first).

split.title: Split
split.description: test = a real leak; dev = allowed (few-shot examples may come from dev), listed only.

Leak.title: Leak
Leak.description: An eval case turn that matches a SQL example: Genie is shown the answer it is tested on.

LibraryView.title: LibraryView
LibraryView.description: What the deployment ships, for the profile editor: the defaults a profile changes.

config_versions.title: Config Versions
config_versions.description: Configuration hash per arm (eval), or `live`: the latest snapshot (check, review).

criteria_set.title: Criteria Set
criteria_set.description: Hash of the whole rule set loaded.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: What else shaped the numbers: k, split, split settings, budgets.

fields.title: Fields
fields.description: Commit, configuration, rule set, model, settings.

cases_changed.title: Cases Changed
cases_changed.description: Asked in both, at a different version or split.

ManifestDiff.title: ManifestDiff
ManifestDiff.description: `GET /spaces/{space_id}/versions/diff?a=&b=`: everything that differs between two runs.

allowed_space_ids.title: Allowed Space Ids
allowed_space_ids.description: Spaces where the viewer holds CAN_MANAGE.

review_space_ids.title: Review Space Ids
review_space_ids.description: Spaces whose reviewer group the viewer belongs to (human review).

review_titles.title: Review Titles
review_titles.description: Title per reviewed space (reviewers cannot look spaces up themselves).

review_sessions.title: Review Sessions
review_sessions.description: Labeling session url per reviewed space, once the review job made one.

Me.title: Me
Me.description: The viewer, as identified by the Databricks Apps proxy headers.

negatives.title: Negatives
negatives.description: Correct items it was run on.

positives.title: Positives
positives.description: Real (or injected) errors it was run on.

Measurement.title: Measurement
Measurement.description:
How well a code criterion's detector was measured against hand labels.
Metadata: it does not change what the criterion checks.

turn_index.title: Turn Index
turn_index.description: 0 = the first turn of its conversation.

caught_by.title: Caught By
caught_by.description: Criteria that fail this turn now (its current verdicts).

suggestion.description: Only while the observation is untagged.

Observation.title: Observation
Observation.description:
A reviewed turn that a reviewer failed or wrote findings on: the raw material of failure
categories. The latest review across reviewers.

reviewed.title: Reviewed
reviewed.description: Turns with a task-success verdict: the denominator of frequency.

passed.title: Passed
passed.description: Of those, turns reviewers passed: where false alarms are counted.

Observations.title: Observations
Observations.description:
`GET /spaces/{space_id}/observations`, owners only. Failed turns come first, blind spots
(failed, caught by nothing) before caught ones.

next_cursor.title: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: Pass back as `cursor` to get the next page; null on the last page.

exact.title: Exact
exact.description: Of those, labels that are the same.

kappa.title: Kappa
kappa.description: Cohen's kappa on fail vs not fail; None until both have used both.

PairAgreement.title: PairAgreement
PairAgreement.description: Two raters on the labels both gave. Fail is the positive class; `a` plays the reference.

Preflight.title: Preflight
Preflight.description:
The tester checks itself before asking anything: a test run as anyone with more access
than a consumer can pass while consumers fail.

custom_rules.title: Custom Rules
custom_rules.description: This space's own LLM-judged rules (family rubric).

base_version.title: Base Version
base_version.description: The version edited (0 = none yet); a newer save is a 409.

old.title: Old
old.description: The current line, exactly (whitespace at the ends ignored).

RetireSuggestion.title: RetireSuggestion
RetireSuggestion.description: Nobody asked anything like this case in the window.

ReviewerPair.title: ReviewerPair
ReviewerPair.description: Agreement between two reviewers on the turns both reviewed: is the rubric clear?

pairs.title: Pairs
pairs.description: Every two reviewers with at least one turn in common.

rule_fail_rate.title: Rule Fail Rate
rule_fail_rate.description: Of rule labels saying the rule applies.

turns_reviewed.title: Turns Reviewed
turns_reviewed.description: Turns with a task-success verdict from this reviewer.

active_7d.title: Active 7D
active_7d.description: Turns they reviewed or labelled in the last 7 days.

median_turnaround_hours.title: Median Turnaround Hours
median_turnaround_hours.description: Median time from a turn being queued to their first verdict on it.

with_judges.description: Their rule labels against the judges' current verdicts (same rule version, no errors). Measures the pair, not the reviewer.

ReviewerStats.title: ReviewerStats
ReviewerStats.description: One reviewer's activity, how strict they are, and how often the judges agree with them.

params.title: Params
params.description: Code rules only: parameters merged over the library's (e.g. restricted columns). A rubric rule's wording is changed by adding a custom rule with its own version.

value.title: Value
value.description: ... has this value (as Dev and test shows it).

RunScope.title: RunScope
RunScope.description:
Part of the eval set, to iterate faster on a dev run: one slice, or the change's targets.
A gate run (split test) always asks every test case plus the targets, so its verdict is never
about a convenient subset. No scope = the whole split.

table.title: Table
table.description: Full table identifier, as in the space's data sources.

SetColumn.title: SetColumn
SetColumn.description: Column metadata Genie reads: a description and synonyms.

reasoning_effort.title: Reasoning Effort
reasoning_effort.description: For reasoning models that read it from the system prompt (gpt-oss).

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: Replaces the library prompt; keep its {placeholders}.

version.title: Version
version.description: The override's own version, needed with a prompt or sampling change. Raise it on every such change: calibration is measured per version.

low.title: Low
low.description: Wilson 95% interval of the pass^k rate.

too_small.title: Too Small
too_small.description: Fewer cases than the space's minimum stratum: read, do not decide.

Slice.title: Slice
Slice.description: pass^k of one arm on the cases with one value of one dimension.

monitored.title: Monitored
monitored.description: True when the collector service principal holds CAN_MANAGE; None when no collect has checked this space yet (a newly registered space).

hard_pass_rate.title: Hard Pass Rate
hard_pass_rate.description: Share of gradable traces with no hard failure.

custom_rules.title: Custom Rules
custom_rules.description: This space's own LLM-judged rules (family rubric).

judge_sample_rate.title: Judge Sample Rate
judge_sample_rate.description: Share of new answers the LLM judges read (the space's settings).

captured_at.title: Captured At
captured_at.description: When the collect job first saw it (not when it was edited).

changes.title: Changes
changes.description: Count change per kind (instructions, sql_examples, snippets, tables, column_configs); empty when only content changed.

SpaceVersionMark.title: SpaceVersionMark
SpaceVersionMark.description: A configuration change of the space, to read the weekly numbers against.

reset.title: Reset
reset.description: Clear every automatic assignment first (overrides stay). Cases that move were seen as dev or test before, so do this before the first gate run, not after.

split.title: Split
split.description: None hands the case back to automatic assignment.

stratify_by.title: Stratify By
stratify_by.description: Dimensions whose combinations get the same dev/test share, coarsest first; empty = a plain random split. Not intent: cases with the same intent stay on one side.

min_stratum.title: Min Stratum
min_stratum.description: A smaller stratum falls back to a coarser one (drop the last dimension).

SplitSettings.title: SplitSettings
SplitSettings.description: How a space's cases are split into dev and test.

unassigned.title: Unassigned
unassigned.description: Active cases not assigned yet: assigned at the next run.

result_schema.title: Result Schema
result_schema.description: Columns as `[{name, type_name}]` from the statement manifest.

source_call_id.title: Source Call Id
source_call_id.description: For a chart: `call_id` of the `execute_sql` step it plots.

Step.title: Step
Step.description: One tool call within a trace.

StepKind.title: StepKind
StepKind.description: `explore` = schema probe; `answer` = query that feeds the report; `viz` = chart.

StratumMix.title: StratumMix
StratumMix.description: Active cases per value of one dimension, in each split.

category_id.title: Category Id
category_id.description: The existing category of that name, if any.

description.title: Description
description.description: For a new category: what the failure looks like.

Suggestion.title: Suggestion
Suggestion.description: An LLM's suggested category for an untagged observation; the owner accepts or ignores it.

category_ids.title: Category Ids
category_ids.description: The observation's categories after the change.

data.title: Data
data.description: required = must run SQL; none = must answer without querying data.

must_not_query.title: Must Not Query
must_not_query.description: Columns or tables the answer's SQL must not touch.

genie_error.title: Genie Error
genie_error.description: Genie's own error message when the turn ended without an answer.

TraceDetail.title: TraceDetail
TraceDetail.description: `GET /traces/{trace_id}`: everything needed to show where a trace fails.

TraceListItem.title: TraceListItem
TraceListItem.description: One row of the trace list.

config_history.title: Config History
config_history.description: The agent's configuration versions, newest first.
